claims.text: The resort is in Banana Bay on the South East Peninsula of St. Kitts.

findings.quote: Banana Bay, South East Peninsula, St. Kitts, Saint Kitts and Nevis

claims.text: Rooms, suites and villas have floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the sea and the neighboring island of Nevis.

findings.quote: Our spacious contemporary designed guestrooms, suites and villas offer expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the sea and neighboring island of Nevis

claims.text: The One Bedroom Bi-Level Villa is a private two-story villa with a rooftop swimming pool, a fully stocked kitchen and laundry facilities.

findings.quote: ## One Bedroom Bi-Level Villa with Rooftop Pool

This private two-story villa features 2,300 square feet of space with floor-to-ceiling windows, a rooftop swimming pool, and 2,165 square feet of deck space. This villa also offers a fully stocked kitchen and laundry facilities.

claims.text: The Three Bedroom Presidential Villa has a game room and a private infinity pool.

findings.quote: Features one bedroom with two queen beds, two bedrooms with a king bed in each, a game room, private infinity pool and spacious terraces.

claims.text: Destination Dining includes dining barefoot on the beach in the evening.

findings.quote: From dining barefoot on St. Kitts beach under the starlit skies with Starlight Dining
findings.note: barefoot beach dining under starlit skies (evening)

claims.text: Island Fort by Camp Hyatt is a complimentary kids club for children ages 3 to 12.

findings.quote: Island Fort by Camp Hyatt offers a complimentary haven for little guests ages 3 to 12 at Park Hyatt St. Kitts.

claims.text: Non-motorized watersports, including kayaking, paddle boarding and snorkeling, are covered by the resort fee.

findings.quote: is applied to each room of your stay in order to provide the following services and amenities
